title: Exploit attempts against SMB (EternalBlue family)
hypothesis: SMB exploit attempts (MS17-010) were made against internal hosts.
queries: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 5145 or EventID == 5140 | where RelativeTargetName contains 'IPC$' | where IpAddress !in (knownPatchMgmt)
rationale: IPC$ access + fail patterns = SMB exploit probing.
